name: timers
algorithm: Variant sleep: per round n tasks (Mk) or goroutines (Go), task i sleeping 1 to 50 ms (splitmix64) then adding i to one atomic counter if the clock shows it slept at least half that; rounds times. Variant deadline: n scopes (Mk Scope.CancelAfter) or contexts (Go context.WithTimeout), each left at once, with a 60 s deadline, which that disarms, or on every 1000th a 0 s deadline, expired already; prints the disarmed plus 3 times the expired (README.md).

skip.c: no std tasks in C (<threads.h> is OS threads; 10^5 cannot be created on Windows, B19, as spawn), and no cancellation scope with a deadline
skip.rust: no std tasks in Rust (std::thread is OS threads; 10^5 cannot be created on Windows, B19, as spawn), and no cancellation scope with a deadline (async runtimes are crates)
skip.zig: no lightweight std tasks in Zig 0.17 on Windows: main's Io is std.Io.Threaded (lib/std/start.zig); Io.concurrent takes a pool thread per busy unit (concurrent_limit unlimited by default) and Io.Group's async, bounded by async_limit (logical CPUs less one), runs a unit at once on the caller past that limit (lib/std/Io/Threaded.zig), so 10^5 concurrent sleepers are not possible (B19, as spawn); its deadlines are std.Io.Timeout arguments of single operations, not a scope's

models.mk: tasks (M:N on 8 carriers), Io.Sleep and Scope.CancelAfter

no_counts: B24 does not apply: the sum of every task's index, each added only after its clock showed it slept, shows that every task slept and ran once, and the deadline checksum (disarmed plus 3 times expired) shows the 0 s deadlines fired and the 60 s ones did not; a 0 s deadline takes each std's at-once path, which arms no timer, so it does not show that a 60 s deadline was armed (README What the checksums show)
notes: Concurrency row (B19): mask 0xff, 8 threads, as spawn. The sleep variant includes about 50 ms of waiting per round in every column (about 0.5 s at the publish size), which pulls its ratios towards 1. Each sleeper reads the clock twice; every 1000th deadline is 0 s and expires (README What the checksums show).
